lines: New supports from game build 85 now count: Skyward Oath (2 sky swords at 24% of a crit, once a second), Stormhound Pact (Storm Wolves leaping for 16% of a crit; the spell must be at least a quarter Lightning) and Rimewake (a frost burst for 25% of a movement skill's hit).
Afterimages: the new "Afterimages deal increased damage" lines (Twin Fang Discipline, idols) now count.

The Dexterity keystone (0.5% more per 10 Dexterity) now counts only for Projectile attacks and Rain of Arrows, as the game says since build 85 (bows only before). Until now the page gave it to melee attacks too.
Hammerbearer's Reliquary: its extra orbiting projectile now also counts on skills with the Orbit support. Vows and Heralds now reserve 20% of your mana, as their gem texts say.
Recent Patch: the history of the oldest game builds (from before the public API) was tidied up.
Game build 85 is in: Recent Patch lists everything it changed (skills, supports, Vows, uniques, the new notables, Oathwords and item mods).

Vows: every Vow line is now 15% stronger, as the game has had since Patch 82 (its gem texts show it: Vow of Iron 50.6% more Armour at gem 20). Fervent Vow adds another 15% of the base (Vow of Iron 57.2%). Builds with Vows read about 1-4% higher.

Executioner and Life Leech: their more damage now counts on hits only, not on Bleed, Poison or Ignite (the game's new texts). Executioner still makes ailments count a little more from the kill at 10% life.
Ruthless: its every-third-blow bonus no longer raises the Bleed or Poison it starts (the game's new text).
Skill tree heat map: colours now rank every node against the rest, with a fold-out legend on the right (lowest, median and top gain per point). Opening the legend turns the heat map on.

Heat map marks: red = taking the node lowers your value, dashed grey = a taken node that loses nothing when refunded, dotted = the node has lines the sim does not count. Node values follow the Prioritize slider (DPS or defence).

Oath seats: empty seats are coloured by their best Oath, and a new "Oath seats open" button in the tree's top left jumps to the next empty seat and opens its Oath menu, which now shows the Oaths side by side.

EHP estimate: glancing blows are in (in-game Evasion tooltip). An attack you cannot evade is cut by your evade chance; the EHP hover box shows your evade chance and the biggest physical hit you survive as a glancing blow. The EHP number itself stays the same.

Bleed: Tear now counts. A crit (or any Slam hit) on a bleeding enemy cashes half the bleed still to come, at most once a second; the game keeps 40% of that as extra damage and takes the rest from later ticks (game logs). Most bleed builds gain about 7-12% bleed damage.

Translations: the newer page text (Saved Builds, full screen tree, Windburst, Gather Fury, freeze bar, Base Grade, Elemental Echo and more) now shows in every page language. New items from game builds 83 and 84 keep their English names until the game's language files have them.
Saved builds: moving to another build while the open one has unsaved changes now asks first: Save, Discard or Cancel.

Frostbreak: its 50% more now counts against Guardians. Cold hits fill the Guardian's freeze bar (12% of its life, each next bar x1.5); each fill gives 5.5 s of the bonus, averaged over the fight. A new box on the Damage tab adds the cold from your other skills.

Dragonling: the Gate kills + Pinnacle box now follows the nodes you take, like the level follows passive points. Take more nodes than your level gives and it goes up by itself, to all Gates, the Seal of 80 and the Pinnacle; past that the level goes up to the milestone that holds them.
Dragonling: the panel now fills the tree view, details on the left and the tree beside them, so the whole tree shows without scrolling. The Taken list shows names; hover one for its text.
Passive tree: a Full screen button next to Fit shows the tree over the whole window, with the points count in the corner. Esc or Exit full screen goes back.
Wake of Spells: Channelling skills supported by the tree's Channel Conduit now show the Linked spell box, so you can pick the spell it casts without a Conduit gem in the sockets.

Saved builds: a saved build now changes only when you press Save. Edits stay as unsaved changes (they survive a refresh), a bar at the top offers Save and Discard changes, and Ctrl+S saves. Your account gets the saved build only.
Item window: the Edit tab is wider and in two columns, so a whole item shows without scrolling on a desktop screen.

Item window: each line now shows what it does to your DPS (green +4.51%), on the item and in the Add Prefix / Add Suffix / Add Vow lists. It is the Damage tab skill's total DPS with the line against without it.

Amulets: the suffix "increased effect of your Vows" (17-20% at the top tier) can now be picked and counts; builds wearing it were missing the line. The item level each tier needs is not confirmed yet.
Gather Fury: while the gem is linked to a skill on your bar, the page now counts 2 Fury charges as held (8% increased damage, 4% attack and cast speed each). Before, it counted nothing.
New box "Fury from Gather Fury" under Vows, Heralds & charges (in Configure Enemy) to change that number. If the Fury box is higher, that number counts instead.
Support Gem Simulator: Gather Fury is now a normal choice instead of sitting under Packs and extras.

Necromancer, Spellbound Dead: a quarter of your Fury charges, your untagged increased damage and Intelligence's spell damage now reaches your minions, as in the game (checked against in-game Summon Skeletons tooltips and the game log). Minion builds with this node read a few % higher.

Item editors and Gear Set Sim: magic and rare items now hold at most 2 runes (rares roll at most 2 sockets). Turning a white item magic or rare drops its 3rd and 4th rune; Oathwords keep their own number of sockets. The Endgame and BiS gear levels plan rares with 2 sockets.
Item window: Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield under Implicits now follow the item's Base Grade and Quality (e.g. Evasion 131 (base 105, grade 125%)).
Ticking Truesworn by hand now sets Base Grade 100. Imported items keep their own grade.
Prefixes, suffixes and Vows show their roll chance on the item's base, as Item Search does (e.g. WEIGHT 22% (100/448)), on the item's lines and in the list when adding one.
Ladder: when the game publishes a hero's build empty for a while, the Ladder shows the last full build the site read and says so.
Support Gem Simulator: one column (search, then Configuration, then the gem setup). Vows, Heralds and charges are now in the Configure Enemy window, which looks the same on every page.

Elemental Echo (Vow): with it on your bar, the Vows, Heralds & charges list has a tick box for each echo (Physical, Fire, Cold, Lightning, Poison): 12% more damage of that element. They start unticked, as an echo needs a kill by your own hit.
Your minions get the echo of their element too (checked against in-game Skeletal Mage tooltips: Fire x1.12, Physical unchanged). The Physical Echo is not counted for minions.
Elemental Echo's Vowbreak box now gives its 20% more damage; before, it did nothing.

Minions: a sworn Oath's lines that name only an element (Oath of the Pyre Heart, Frozen Heart, Storm Heart) now count for your minions too, as tree and item lines already did (checked against in-game Skeletal Mage tooltips).
Skill tree search: every matching node and Oath seat now gets a red ring, matching names turn red when zoomed in, and the number of matches shows under the search box.
Minions: the young-gem bonus of a summon gem (Summon Skeletons: up to 30% more below gem level 16) now counts for its minions too.
Summon Skeletons: they attack a little slower, as the game shows (fitted to the game log; Multistrike does not change it). Builds with Skeletons read lower, fast armies the most.
